links.outcome: Model performance variation across k-means patient subgroups versus aggregate performance
links.effect: Overall performance was high (µ = 0.855), but performance varied significantly within five clinical clusters (F = 73.18, p < 0.001); TabPFN underperformed in the Immunodeficient cluster.
links.quote: Unsupervised k-means clustering identified five clinically distinct patient subgroups with mortality rates ranging from 22% to 80%, within which model performance varied significantly (F = 73.18, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Evaluate algorithmic multiplicity (divergent individual-level predictions among similarly performing models) before choosing a model

screen.reason: Evaluates algorithmic multiplicity and subgroup-level predictive divergence across different models with similar global metrics to assess safety and equity in model selection.
